statements.status_notes: Fixed upstream in golang.org/x/text v0.39.0. package/main/kubernetes's pin-dependencies step (which already pins x/crypto, otel, otel/sdk, cel-go, grpc, and x/net for other CVEs) does not yet pin x/text, so kubeadm/kubectl/kubelet ship the version resolved by kubernetes' own go.mod at build time (0.37.0). Affects image/kubeadm, an internal .block'ed CI test-harness image used to bootstrap ephemeral clusters for other images' integration tests -- not a customer-facing product. Tracking for the package/main/kubernetes pin to be added.

Affects image/kubeadm, an internal .block'ed CI test-harness image used to bootstrap ephemeral clusters for other images' integration tests -- not a customer-facing product. Tracking for the package/main/kubernetes pin to be added.

golang.org/x/text 0.37.0 and 0.38.0 are vendored into the reused upstream docker engine stack and buildx apks. Reachability from the shipped binaries is under assessment; remediation requires rebuilding those apks against golang.org/x/text 0.39.0, which the version tracker will pull in on the next apk bump.
